start.text: Welcome to the Rutgers CORE Building! I'm here to help you explore the spaces our Industrial & Systems Engineering students use to learn, design, and work on projects.

controls.text: Use WASD or your arrow keys to move, your mouse to look around, and E to talk to guides. The tracker in the corner shows who you've met and which guides you still have to visit!

where_to_start.text: I recommend starting with the 3D Printing Room, where you can see how students turn their designs into real objects. But feel free to explore wherever you'd like!

goodbye.text: Enjoy exploring Rutgers CORE! Feel free to come back if you need a reminder of how the tour works.
